newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers dip in thin trade and good supplies.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers dip in thin trade and good supplies.

text.p: ARA bunker fuel was a touch softer on Wednesday despite a move late in the day on paper to push prices higher.
Dealers said meagre demand of 8-9,000 tonnes was easily met by good supplies. A major was seen to have done several bunkers at $113.
380 cst was pegged at $113-114 delivered on board and 180 cst 118-119.
The easier prices were not attracting shipowners who have been put off by recent high levels.

"They (shippers) see a falling market and are waiting to see where it levels out before going in," said one bunker trader, who added, "It's only those people who have to take on board fuel who are doing so".
